name: Viper-CTR ~Asuka~
source:
The sequel to the short VIPER-V10 story, Northern Lights, subtitled Asuka. The budding romance between Asuka and Captain is put to the test when Captain's sultry cousin Miki moves in with him. Captain's focus wavers...
 
[From [url=http://www.sognadigitalmuseum.com/products/games/ctr.html]sognadigitalmuseum[/url]]
translation:
这是短篇《VIPER-V10：Northern Lights》的续作，副标题为“明日香”。明日香与队长之间刚刚萌芽的恋情迎来考验：队长性感的表妹美纪搬来与他同住，队长的心思开始动摇……

[更多信息见[url=http://www.sognadigitalmuseum.com/products/games/ctr.html]sognadigitalmuseum[/url]]
